title_en: Professorship for Natural Language Processing — TH Köln
title: Professorship for Natural Language Processing
title_ar: أستاذية في معالجة اللغات الطبيعية - جامعة كولونيا
description_en: W2 Professorship (permanent, full-time) in Natural Language Processing at TH Köln University of Applied Sciences, Faculty of Information Science and Communication Studies, Campus Südstadt, Cologne. The successful candidate teaches in Bachelor's and Master's programs in German and English, conducts research, acquires third-party funding, and participates in self-management. Requires a university degree in computer science or information/library/communication science and a doctorate with in-depth NLP knowledge.
description: Permanent W2 Professorship in NLP at TH Köln, Germany. Teaching in German and English, research, third-party funding.

title_en: PostDoctoral Positions in Natural Language Processing — KU Leuven, Belgium
title: PostDoctoral Positions in Natural Language Processing
title_ar: مناصب ما بعد الدكتوراه في معالجة اللغات الطبيعية - جامعة لوفان، بلجيكا
description_en: Three postdoctoral positions at the Language Intelligence and Information Retrieval (LIIR) lab, Department of Computer Science, KU Leuven, Belgium. Positions: (1) Machine Reading Comprehension and NLU (ERC Advanced Grant CALCULUS), (2) Memory Storage and Retrieval Inspired by Biological Brains, (3) Joint Processing of Language and Visual Data. 2-year postdoctoral fellowship, competitive salary, GPU cluster access. Requires PhD in Computer Science with strong ML publication record.
description: 3 Postdoc positions in NLP/ML at KU Leuven LIIR lab: reading comprehension, memory, and multimodal NLP.
description_ar: ثلاثة مناصب لباحثي ما بعد الدكتوراه في مختبر ذكاء اللغة واسترجاع المعلومات بجامعة لوفان في بلجيكا.

title_en: Researcher in Natural Language Processing (ref 283057) — University of Oslo
title: Researcher in Natural Language Processing
title_ar: باحث في معالجة اللغات الطبيعية - جامعة أوسلو
description_en: Researcher position at the Language Technology Group (LTG), Department of Informatics, University of Oslo, Norway. Part of a cross-disciplinary research project on generative approaches to event extraction within the socio-political domain. Requires PhD in NLP or Computer Science with NLP-based thesis, broad knowledge of deep neural architectures. The group works on event extraction, sentiment analysis, and LLM training and benchmarking. Temporary full-time position (37.5h/week).
description: Researcher in NLP at University of Oslo LTG, event extraction in socio-political domain, PhD required.
description_ar: منصب باحث في معالجة اللغات الطبيعية بمجموعة تكنولوجيا اللغة في جامعة أوسلو بالنرويج.

description_en: Postdoctoral researcher position at the Group for Vision and Intelligent Systems (GVIS), University of León, Spain, funded by NextGenerationEU. Focus on cybersecurity and cybercrime prevention using NLP and Computer Vision: detection of fraudulent messages, phishing, CSAM, grooming, data obfuscation. Requires PhD in Computer Science, 3+ years Python, significant publication record. Salary up to €46,581 gross/year. Must reside in León, Spain.
description: Postdoc in NLP/CV at Universidad de León GVIS, cybersecurity/cybercrime focus, up to €46K salary.

title_ar: باحث ما بعد الدكتوراه في معالجة اللغات الطبيعية - مشروع SIESTA
description_en: Postdoctoral researcher position at GVIS, University of León, Spain, funded by Horizon Europe. Part of the SIESTA project (Secure Interactive Environments for SensiTive data Analytics) on text anonymization of sensitive cybersecurity data. Focus: text anonymization, text classification, NLP and Deep Learning for cybercrime prevention. Requires PhD in Computer Science, 3+ years Python, European research project experience. Salary €30,000–€45,000 gross/year. Must reside in León.

description_en: Open Rank Faculty positions (Assistant, Associate, Full Professor) in the Department of Natural Language Processing at Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI), Abu Dhabi, UAE. title_en: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Natural Language Processing (ref 270966) — University of Oslo
title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in NLP
title_ar: باحث ما بعد الدكتوراه في معالجة اللغات الطبيعية - جامعة أوسلو
description_en: Postdoctoral Research Fellow position at the Language Technology Group (LTG), University of Oslo, Norway, within the MediaFutures centre. Focus: alignment of generative language models, mitigating biases and toxicity. Tasks include resource creation (instruction-tuning datasets, dialogue data) and preference-optimization. Requires PhD in NLP or Computer Science with NLP thesis. The candidate will perform secondments at industry partners and publish high-impact papers. Full-time 37.5h/week.

title: Associate Professor in ML for NLP
title_ar: أستاذ مشارك في التعلم الآلي لمعالجة اللغات الطبيعية - تيليكوم باريس
description_en: Permanent Associate Professor position in Machine Learning for Natural Language Processing at Télécom Paris (Institut Mines-Télécom, Institut Polytechnique de Paris), hosted by the S²A team in the IDS department. Tasks include teaching ML for language processing and research in deep learning, generative models, conversational AI, bias/explainability, and frugal ML. Requires PhD, English fluency, NLP expertise. 49 days annual leave, flexible hours, 1-3 days telework/week. Application deadline: October 11, 2024.
description: Permanent Associate Professor in ML/NLP at Télécom Paris. Generative AI, bias, frugal ML. Permanent contract.
